vsm1.3:1.1: Idāni yasmā evaṃ dhutaṅgapariharaṇasampāditehi appicchatādīhi guṇehi pariyodāte imasmiṃ sīle patiṭṭhitena ‘‘sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañca bhāvaya’’nti vacanato cittasīsena niddiṭṭho samādhi bhāvetabbo.
vsm1.3:1.2: So ca atisaṅkhepadesitattā viññātumpi tāva na sukaro, pageva bhāvetuṃ,
vsm1.3:1.3: tasmā tassa vitthārañca bhāvanānayañca dassetuṃ idaṃ pañhākammaṃ hoti.
vsm1.3:2.3: Taṃ sabbaṃ vibhāvayituṃ ārabbhamānaṃ vissajjanaṃ adhippetañceva atthaṃ na sādheyya,
vsm1.3:2.5: tasmā idhādhippetameva sandhāya vadāma, kusalacittekaggatā samādhi.
vsm1.3:3.3: Ekārammaṇe cittacetasikānaṃ samaṃ sammā ca ādhānaṃ,
vsm1.3:3.5: Tasmā yassa dhammassānubhāvena ekārammaṇe cittacetasikā samaṃ sammā ca avikkhipamānā avippakiṇṇā ca hutvā tiṭṭhanti,
vsm1.3:4.5: ‘‘Sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyatī’’ti vacanato pana sukhamassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
vsm1.3:6.4: upasamānussatiyā āhāre paṭikūlasaññāya catudhātuvavatthānassāti imesaṃ vasena laddhacittekaggatā,
vsm1.3:6.5: yā ca appanāsamādhīnaṃ pubbabhāge ekaggatā, ayaṃ upacārasamādhi.
vsm1.3:6.6: ‘‘Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo’’ti ādivacanato pana yā parikammānantarā ekaggatā, ayaṃ appanāsamādhīti
vsm1.3:7.1: Dutiyaduke tīsu bhūmīsu kusalacittekaggatā lokiyo samādhi.
vsm1.3:8.2: catukkanaye dvīsu pañcakanaye tīsu jhānesu ekaggatā sappītiko samādhi.
vsm1.3:8.3: Avasesesu dvīsu jhānesu ekaggatā nippītiko samādhi.
vsm1.3:8.4: Upacārasamādhi pana siyā sappītiko, siyā nippītikoti
vsm1.3:9.2: catukkanaye tīsu pañcakanaye catūsu jhānesu ekaggatā sukhasahagato samādhi.
vsm1.3:9.4: Upacārasamādhi pana siyā sukhasahagato, siyā upekkhāsahagatoti
vsm1.3:11.4: Yo hi vitakkamatteyeva ādīnavaṃ disvā vicāre adisvā
vsm1.3:11.9: pañcakanaye tatiyādīsu tīsu jhānesu ekaggatā avitakkāvicāro samādhīti
vsm1.3:12.3: pañcakanaye ca tīsu jhānesu ekaggatā pītisahagato samādhi.
vsm1.3:12.4: Tesveva tatiye ca catutthe ca jhāne ekaggatā sukhasahagato samādhi.
vsm1.3:12.6: Upacārasamādhi pana pītisukhasahagato vā hoti upekkhāsahagato vāti
vsm1.3:14.1: Catukkesu paṭhamacatukke atthi samādhi dukkhāpaṭipado dandhābhiñño,
vsm1.3:15.1: Tattha paṭhamasamannāhārato paṭṭhāya yāva tassa tassa jhānassa upacāraṃ uppajjati,
vsm1.3:15.5: Sā panesā paṭipadā ekaccassa dukkhā hoti,
vsm1.3:15.9: Abhiññāpi ekaccassa dandhā hoti mandā asīghappavatti.
vsm1.3:16.4: tesu yo asappāyasevī hoti, tassa dukkhā paṭipadā dandhā ca abhiññā hoti.
vsm1.3:16.5: Sappāyasevino sukhā paṭipadā khippā ca abhiññā.
vsm1.3:16.6: Yo pana pubbabhāge asappāyaṃ sevitvā aparabhāge sappāyasevī hoti,
vsm1.3:16.7: pubbabhāge vā sappāyaṃ sevitvā aparabhāge asappāyasevī,
vsm1.3:16.12: Appanākosallāni pana asampādentassa dandhā abhiññā hoti.
vsm1.3:17.7: Yo ca samathe akatādhikāro, tassa dukkhā paṭipadā hoti.
vsm1.3:17.9: Yo pana vipassanāya akatādhikāro hoti, tassa dandhā abhiññā hoti,
vsm1.3:18.3: dukkhā paṭipadā hoti dandhā ca abhiññā,
vsm1.3:18.6: sukhā paṭipadā hoti dandhā ca abhiññā.
vsm1.3:19.2: yo puggalo dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhāya ca abhiññāya samādhiṃ pāpuṇāti,
vsm1.3:19.3: tassa so samādhi dukkhāpaṭipado dandhābhiññoti vuccati.
vsm1.3:20.5: Tattha yo samādhi appaguṇo uparijhānassa paccayo bhavituṃ na sakkoti, ayaṃ paritto.
vsm1.3:20.6: Yo pana avaḍḍhite ārammaṇe pavatto, ayaṃ parittārammaṇo.
vsm1.3:20.7: Yo paguṇo subhāvito, uparijhānassa paccayo bhavituṃ sakkoti, ayaṃ appamāṇo.
vsm1.3:20.8: Yo ca vaḍḍhite ārammaṇe pavatto, ayaṃ appamāṇārammaṇo.
vsm1.3:21.1: Tatiyacatukke vikkhambhitanīvaraṇānaṃ vitakkavicārapītisukhasamādhīnaṃ vasena pañcaṅgikaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ,
vsm1.3:21.4: tato pahīnasukhaṃ upekkhāvedanāsahitassa samādhino vasena duvaṅgikaṃ catutthaṃ.
vsm1.3:21.5: Iti imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ aṅgabhūtā cattāro samādhī honti.
vsm1.3:22.18: Tāya pana paññāya sampayuttā samādhīpi cattāro hontīti.
vsm1.3:24.2: ‘‘chandaṃ ce bhikkhu adhipatiṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ, ayaṃ vuccati chandasamādhi…pe…
vsm1.3:24.5: vīmaṃsaṃ ce bhikkhu adhipatiṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ , ayaṃ vuccati vīmaṃsāsamādhī’’ti (vibha. 432; saṃ. ni. 3.825)
vsm1.3:25.1: Pañcake yaṃ catukkabhede vuttaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ,
vsm1.3:25.3: vitakkavicārātikkamena tatiyanti evaṃ dvidhā bhinditvā pañca jhānāni veditabbāni.
vsm1.3:26.1: Ko cassa saṃkileso kiṃ vodānanti ettha pana vissajjanaṃ vibhaṅge vuttameva.
vsm1.3:26.2: Vuttañhi tattha ‘‘saṃkilesanti hānabhāgiyo dhammo. Vodānanti visesabhāgiyo dhammo’’ti (vibha. 828).
vsm1.3:26.5: hānabhāginī paññā’’ti (vibha. 799) iminā nayena hānabhāgiyadhammo veditabbo.
vsm1.3:26.7: visesabhāginī paññā’’ti (vibha. 799) iminā nayena visesabhāgiyadhammo veditabbo.
